row.team_price_text: Contact Sales (no public pricing; Book a Demo)
row.evidence: Planful publishes no pricing (planful.com/pricing returns 404; the site offers Book a Demo) and its product help "is now a private resource available to logged-in users"; the only public identity doc covers SAML SSO for Planful for Marketing, enabled by the CSM.
row.notes: New in 2026-09. Quote-only FP&A and consolidation platform (formerly Host Analytics). No public price list. Core product help and API docs moved behind the customer login, so SCIM and user-API availability cannot be verified; status unknown. The public Planful for Marketing help documents SAML SSO switched on by the Customer Success Manager, with users still added manually on the My Team page (no JIT). Not found in the Okta OIN, Entra gallery or JumpCloud catalogue under planful or host-analytics slugs.

scim.notes: Not determinable: Planful's product help (help.planful.com) is private to logged-in customers, the public llms.txt only exposes Planful for Marketing pages, and no SCIM mention was found on planful.com, its trust centre or IdP catalogues.

user_api.notes: API documentation sits behind the customer login. The public MCP server is read-only and OAuth-based (not user management).

okta.notes: okta.com/integrations/planful/ and legacy host-analytics slugs returned 404.

entra.notes: Entra planful-tutorial, planful-provisioning-tutorial and host-analytics-tutorial returned 404.

fallbacks.notes: jit false applies to Planful for Marketing, where SSO only authenticates users who already exist on the My Team page. Core Planful (FP&A, consolidation) docs are private.
